Dear Sir(s) / Madam(s), 
 
Subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 – update on appeal in the 
matter of Asier Metals Private Limited vs. Polycab India Limited. 
In continuation of our earlier intimations dated October 07, 2026 , October 08, 2026 , October 09, 2026 ,  
October 14, 2026 and October 16, 2026, we wish to inform that Hon'ble National Company Law Appellate 
Tribunal ("Hon'ble NCLAT"), Principal Bench, New Delhi has vide its order dated October 27, 2026 directed 
MSCI not to delist the scrip of Polycab from MSCI Index  till the pronouncement of the order. A copy of the 
NCLAT order is attached herewith. 
 
The said order has also been intimated to MSCI on October 27,2026 
 
The Company shall continue to notify the Stock exchanges of material events or information upon its 
occurrence. 
 
Kindly take the same on your record. 
Thanking you 
 
Yours Faithfully, 
For Polycab India Limited

ORDER  
(ON MENTIONING) 
 
27.10.2026: This Appeal is reserved for orders and in the meanwhile, it 
is submitted by the Ld. Senior Counsel for the Appellant in case the order is 
not pronounced today, the MSCI Index may de -list the P olycab stock in its 
next review cycle, which cycle starts on 28.10.2026. 
2. Since the matter is reserved for orders, we direct that no action as 
aforesaid be taken by MSCI till we pronounce the order.
